comment: topten.c tt_oname() through mkmaze.c fixup_special()'s Medusa statues. Segment 0: a Valkyrie kills her kitten for score points and quits, writing a 20-point entry to the record file. Segment 1: a wizard-mode Priest level-teleports to Medusa's level, whose mk_tt_object() statues draw rnd(tt_oname_maxrank), read that entry, and take its role, gender and name instead of the empty-scoreboard rn1() fallback.
